newsitem.title: USA: Overseas Shipholding Group says merger completed.
newsitem.headline: Overseas Shipholding Group says merger completed.

text.p: Joint venture company Celebrity Cruise Lines Inc has completed its previously announced $1.3 billion merger with Royal Caribbean, Overseas Shipholding Group Inc said on Thursday.
Overseas Shipholding, together with the Greek-based Chandris Group, is a partner in the Celebrity joint venture.
As a 49 percent owner of Celebrity, Overseas Shipholding said it received roughly $120 million in cash and 3.65 million shares of Royal Caribbean common stock in the transaction.
The company added that it will use cash proceeds from the deal to reduce indebtedness.
Overseas Shipholding is a bulk shipping company that owns and operates 62 vessels.
